description: One segment of the canon in the Pali root and every available translation side by side. Use a segment id from search/get_text, e.g. "mn129:21.3". Sujato (en_sujato) is excluded unless named in translators.

langs.description: Limit to these languages, e.g. ["ru","en"]. Default: all.

segmentId.description: Segment id as returned by search, e.g. mn129:21.3 or dn22:1.1.

translators.description: Explicit translator keys, e.g. ["en_sujato"] to include Sujato.

name: compare_translations
